registered_at: 2026-10-23, before any script, feature or outcome
batch: untested-categories 2026-10-23 (operator: 'I want to test all of these')
study: Opening-range breakout on stocks in play (Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz 2024): each day trade only the names with the most abnormal opening volume, buying a break above the first 5-minute range.
source: Zarattini, Barbon, Aziz (SSRN 4729284): universe = 1,000 most liquid US stocks, price > $5, 14-day ATR > $0.50; in play = first-5-minute volume / its 14-day average for the same window; top 20 per day; direction of the first 5-minute candle; stop at 10% of ATR... reported Sharpe ~2.8 (2016-2023), QuantConnect recreation Sharpe 2.4. Backtest only, not peer reviewed. Our 9/26 test (top-10 GAINERS, small sample) is not this design.
prior: LOW-MEDIUM (~15%): published backtest, unreviewed; our breakout and early-entry tests failed, but never with opening-volume selection.
data: Fresh fetch on the data-only account: (1) daily SIP bars 2026-03-01 .. 2026-10-15 for all active US common stocks (to rank liquidity and ATR); (2) SIP 1-minute bars 09:30-09:34 for the 1,000 most liquid names each day (prior 20-day median dollar volume, price > $10, ATR(14) > $0.50), 2026-04-01 .. 2026-10-15 (the first 14 sessions of opening volume are warm-up); (3) full-day SIP 1-minute bars for each day's top-20 names only. Sessions 2026-05-11 .. 2026-10-15, halves as common.
signal: In-play score = volume of the 09:30-09:34 bars / mean of the same window over the prior 14 sessions (needs >= 10 of them). Top 20 names per day by score. LONG candidates: those whose first 5-minute candle closed above its open (paper's direction rule).
trade: Buy stop at the 5-minute range high + $0.01, triggered from the 09:35 bar on (fill at max(trigger, bar open)); stop loss = 5-minute range low (paper variant uses 10% of ATR; information); exit at the 15:59 close if not stopped (paper exits at the close). One trade per name-day. Long only (desk); the short side is information.
control: For each triggered trade, the SAME name-day bought at a seeded random minute in 09:35..11:00 (seed 'orb-ctrl'), same stop distance in percent, same 15:59 exit. Isolates the breakout timing from the in-play name selection.
primary: Per day: mean trade net; and LIFT = mean (trade - its control).
pass: In BOTH halves: mean trade net (after 5 bp) > 0 with t >= 2.0 AND LIFT >= 0 (the breakout is not worse than a random entry in the same name). Selection-only evidence (net > 0 but LIFT < 0) is reported as 'in-play names drift, timing adds nothing'.
no_retuning: Universe, score, top 20, 5-minute range, stop, exit, cost, sample fixed.

common.halves: Warehouse studies: A = 2026-05-11 .. 2026-07-29, B = 2026-07-30 .. 2026-10-15 (110 sessions; 2026-04-27 .. 05-08 are warm-up for look-backs only).
common.statistic_default: Per half: per day, the mean over that day's trades of the measured quantity; day-equal mean; day-clustered t (df = days - 1).
common.cost: 5 bp round trip binding (the desk's current RT cost on $20+ names is ~3 bp); net also printed at 3, 10, 20 bp.
common.price_floor: entry price >= $10 primary; >= $20 (the desk's live floor) as information.
common.confirmation: A PASS is re-run unchanged on warehouse_confirm (2026-01-14 .. 04-24, held out, never read) before anything else; then a forward paper prereg. Never a desk change by itself; the desk stays frozen for the floor20 window.
common.power: Outcome-blind count step first: trades and days per half, and a projected MDE from the dispersion of the CONTROL leg only; floors per half >= 300 trades and >= 20 days, MDE <= the lift bar, else UNDERPOWERED with no outcome read.
common.fail_rule: FAIL: t <= -2 in a half, or the 97.5% upper bound of the lift below the bar in both halves. Otherwise not passed = UNDERPOWERED.
common.data_account: All fetches on the data-only Alpaca account (secrets_data.json), never the desk key; paced; no paid data.
common.multiplicity: Eight studies registered together on 2026-10-23 (the 'untested categories' batch). Each has ONE primary; a family-wise reading is printed: a primary counts as a batch PASS only with t >= 2.73 (Bonferroni 0.05/8, two-sided, normal approx) in both halves; t >= 2 in both halves without that is reported as 'PASS (single-test), not batch-robust'.
amended: (C1) Cross-sectional studies (no control leg): the power MDE comes from a PLACEBO - a seeded random set of the same size as the long set each day (seed '<study>-placebo') minus the all-eligible mean; MDE = (t 2.0 + 0.84) x SD(day placebo LIFT) / sqrt(days). The placebo is outcome-free with respect to the signal.

(C2) No eligibility test may use a bar after entry. Exit price = the close of the last bar at or before the exit minute; a name lacking the exit-minute bar is NOT skipped. A name lacking its entry bar is skipped (counted) - the entry bar is known at entry.
(C3) Confirmation window for fresh-fetch studies: 2026-01-14 .. 2026-04-24 (the warehouse_confirm dates), fetched ONLY after a PASS, never before; no study's scored halves may include it.
(C4) Every fetch logs symbols dropped by rate-limit errors (429) after retries; a half with any unrecovered drop is refused (rerun the fetch).

Universe fact (declared): the warehouse is NOT book-like - it is every liquid name (prior-day raw close >= $10, 20-day mean dollar volume >= $20M, active and inactive, ~1,840-1,950 per day); bars end at 15:59 (no closing auction).

The old A/B split is replaced (A and B were counted, never scored).
amended_5.change_power: Projected MDE per half ~10.5-11 bp, at the 10 bp floor's edge. PRIMARY power gate moves to the POOLED sample (both halves, ~2,600 sessions, projected MDE ~7.6 bp <= 10 bp); each half must still meet >= 300 long trades and >= 20 days.
amended_5.change_pass: PASS only if ALL: (1) pooled mean net after 10 bp > 0, with day-clustered t >= 2.0 AND month-clustered t >= 2.0; (2) net > 0 and SPY-hedged LIFT >= 0 in EACH half (point); (3) pooled SPY-hedged net > 0 and pooled SPY-hedged LIFT >= 0. Hedge = trade minus SPY RAW 1m return over the same entry and exit minutes, beta 1; (4) pooled net > 0 after dropping the best calendar year; (5) the power gate. Batch-robust = pooled day-clustered t >= 2.73 and both halves' t > 0. FAIL if pooled t <= -2, or either half's t <= -2, or the pooled 97.5% upper bound <= 0. Raw LIFT is information only.
amended_5.change_universe: Unchanged rules (ever-liquid list incl. delisted names, top 1,000 by prior 20-day median dollar volume, raw prior close > $10, ATR(14) > $0.50, top 20 by opening-volume score, green first candle, buy stop at range high + $0.01, stop at range low, exit at the 15:59 close). Declared: the ever-liquid list was built for 2016+ (gap-down study), so 2016 coverage is as complete as that list.

Resumable; runs on the data-only key after hours and weekends, one heavy job at a time; days with a failed batch are retried, never scored partially. Full-day RAW minute bars for each day's top 20 as before. By year, and 2016-2023 (the paper's window) vs 2024-2026 (after publication).
amended_5.confidence: ~20-25% PASS (Claude, before any data; the Lever-1 brief).
amended_5.coverage_step: Before any outcome, by year, printed and gated: (a) share of top-1,000 name-days with all 5 opening minutes: >= 90% every year, else that year is excluded and declared; (b) median of 09:30-09:34 volume / daily volume; (c) share of top-20 name-days with full-day bars: >= 98%; (d) names that died per year, 2016 included: the 2016 count must be at least half the 2017-19 mean; (e) the 1,000th-name cutoff >= $20M on every scored day: a HARD abort, not a print. Failure of (c) means refetch; if it still fails, ABORT. Failure of (d) means 2016 is excluded and declared (H1 starts 2017-01-03). After any year exclusion, the pooled MDE and the per-half floors are recomputed before any outcome is read. Exclusions are final.
amended_5.follow_on: If the 2024-2026 net <= 0, the result is 'DECAYED, no forward'. A PASS is SIP-only, and a forward test needs an IEX-score cell (2021+) or paid SIP before any desk use. The held-out confirmation (about 70 sessions, MDE ~46 bp) can only falsify (t <= -2), not confirm.
amended_5.cost_note: Net at 20 bp printed for H1; a PASS with H1 20-bp net <= 0 is labelled COST-FRAGILE.
amended_5.declared_coverage: The ever-liquid list (Alpaca assets ACTIVE + INACTIVE, gapdown_short.py) loses tickers later reused by another company (no as-of mapping), heaviest in 2016-18: a bias in H1, gated by coverage step (d).
amended_5.supersedes: This replaces the base 'pass', amended_4 (2) per-half MDE gate and amended_4 (5) verdict. HALVES = H1/H2. count.json floors: per half >= 300 long trades and >= 20 days. The MDE gate is pooled only.
amended_5.hedge_def: SPY RAW 1m full-day bars are fetched with each day's top 20 (same request). Hedged return = trade gross - (SPY close of the exit bar / SPY open of the entry bar - 1). The entry bar is the trigger bar for the trade and the random bar for the control. The exit bar is the stop bar or the last bar <= 15:59. Hedged LIFT = hedged trade - hedged control. A missing SPY bar means the day is refused and counted; the run aborts if more than 0.5% of days are refused.
amended_5.month_t_def: Month-clustered t = mean of the per-month means of the day means / (SD of the month means / sqrt(months)), df = months - 1.
amended_5.drop_best_year_def: Best year = the calendar year with the highest mean of its day means of net. Recompute the pooled day-equal mean without it; it must be > 0.
amended_5.selection_only: Pooled net conditions (1) and (4) are met, but hedged LIFT < 0 in a half or pooled: report 'SELECTION ONLY (in-play names drift, timing adds nothing)', not PASS.
amended_5.session_index: Look-back and union windows count sessions per half and never bridge the gap 2026-01-13 -> 2026-04-27. The 04-27 .. 05-22 sessions are warm-up only.
amended_5.multiplicity: No by-year, post-publication, $20+ or hedge-variant cell can be promoted without its own prereg.
amended_5.power_note: Round-2 reviewer estimate (not measured): joint PASS probability ~65-75% at a true +10 bp edge and ~80% at +15 bp if the timing is real; ~30% per-half hedged LIFT if timing adds nothing. Nothing relaxed.
